title: Files, links, media
intro: Mobbin evidence for cross-course resource reuse and in-context preview/playback.

questions.title: Upload + link + embed handled in one place vs. separate features
Organisation model (flat list / folders / sections tied to course structure)
Reuse across courses (central library vs. per-course silo)
Preview and inline playback without leaving the course
Visibility controls (draft / scheduled / per-group) and how they are surfaced

references.title: All-files library with shared folders
references.question: Q3
references.take: A persistent All files view places shared folders beside personal folders, giving an explicit central-library pattern for resources reused by multiple courses.

references.title: Central files grid with Libraries & brands
references.question: Q3
references.take: A file grid combines an All filter with a separate Libraries & brands destination, showing how a shared asset area can sit alongside ordinary files.

references.title: Adding a file
references.question: Q3
references.take: The file flow moves from an Add files entry in course editing through file selection and completion, evidence of a course-scoped attachment path rather than proof of cross-course reuse.

references.title: Adding course activities
references.question: Q3
references.take: The course-activity flow shows selecting and moving activities within a course, useful as a siloed-structure counterpoint when designing reuse.

references.title: Lesson links, downloads and video list
references.question: Q4
references.take: A lesson page keeps a Chapter resources download row above a Videos list, so media and supporting files are discoverable in the same course context.

references.title: Lesson video with downloads panel
references.question: Q4
references.take: A large lesson video remains visible beside the lesson outline while a Downloads card exposes a PDF link in the same view.

references.title: Inline course video with playback controls
references.question: Q4
references.take: The course lesson embeds the video player directly above transcript and notes tabs, with autoplay, quality, speed and subtitles controls exposed in place.

references.title: Mobile lesson player with download action
references.question: Q4
references.take: The iOS lesson player keeps Share, Bookmark and Download actions directly beneath playback, followed by description and upcoming lessons.

references.title: Mobile lesson with attachment tab
references.question: Q4
references.take: Coursera's mobile lesson pairs video with Transcript, Notes, Summary and Attachments tabs, keeping supplementary material inside the lesson shell.

references.title: Mobile course player with course files note
references.question: Q4
references.take: The iOS course player shows a download progress control and an in-course note directing learners to course files and resources.

references.title: View file flow
references.question: Q4
references.take: The file-view flow provides a compact sequence for opening a library item and moving into its preview state without leaving the file workspace.

references.title: Playing a video flow
references.question: Q4
references.take: The video flow shows a dedicated in-product player sequence, supporting inline playback as a deliberate interaction rather than a link-out.
